title: Bernstein Functions at Work: Coalescents, Copulas, and Subordination
summary: Several positivity questions in stochastic processes, dependence modeling, fractional analysis, and renewal theory reduce to a common recognition task: after normalization, identify the object as a Laplace transform, a potential density, an inverse-flow coefficient, or a finite kernel average, and then read the sign pattern from that representation. We develop this recognition calculus for completely monotone functions, Bernstein functions, special Bernstein functions, and probabilistic realizations through subordinators and mixing measures.
